articles.summary: Our advertising platform at Snap receives a large volume of new ads every day. To maintain a high-quality and relevant ad ecosystem, we need to review these creatives at scale, to ensure they align with our policies, are safe for our community, and are shown to the right Snapchatters.
articles.title: Snap Ads Understanding: From Pixels to Words

articles.summary: We’re excited to share our new Snapchat Family Safety Hub, developed with guidance from Common Sense Media. Our new Family Hub is designed to help families navigate Snapchat safely and confidently. As part of our continued efforts to support families, the site offers comprehensive resources and information to equip parents and teens with essential tools to support their safety and digital well-being.
articles.title: Introducing our New Snapchat Family Safety Hub
